harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: (الرحمن) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause {عَلَّمَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «خلق» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «علَّمه» is a third khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: (الشمس والقمر بحسبان) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «السماء» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it; the clause of the implied verb is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «علَّمه البيان», and the clause «رفعها» is explicative. The clause «ووضع» is conjoined to the implied clause «رفع».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: (ألا تطغوا في الميزان) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition lām.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «وأقيموا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «تطغوا»; the preposition «بالقسط» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «الأرض» is the object of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, and the clause of the implied verb is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «وضع الميزان» in verse (7).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «فيها فاكهة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الأرض»; «ذات» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «الحب» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «النخل»; «ذو» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The fāʾ connects (rābiṭa) to the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, i.e. "if the matter is so"; «بأي» is an interrogative noun, genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تكذبان».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The preposition «من نار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مارج».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «رب» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "He is the Lord", and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «يلتقيان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «البحرين».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «بينهما برزخ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «البحرين», as is the clause «لا يبغيان».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «وله الجوار» is resumptive; «الجوار» is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, which is omitted for lightness. «المنشآت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الجوار»; the preposition «في البحر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «الجوار»; the preposition «كالأعلام» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «المنشآت».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «من» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «فان» is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ).

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «كل» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the notion of being (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached, and the clause «هو في شأن» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «سنفرغ» is resumptive, as is the clause «أيها الثقلان»; «الثقلان» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The conditional clause is the response to the vocative, resumptive; the clause «لا تنفذون» is resumptive; the preposition «بسلطان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تنفذون».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «يُرْسَل» is resumptive; the preposition «من نار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شواظ»; and the clause «فلا تنتصران» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «يُرْسَل».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «فكانت» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «انشقت»; the preposition «كالدهان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «وردة»; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "you would see a great terror".

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The fāʾ is conjunctive; «يوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسأل»; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is for compensation; the clause «لا يسأل» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the preceding implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «يعرف» is resumptive; the preposition «بسيماهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المجرمون»; the clause «فيؤخذ» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «يعرف»; the preposition «بالنواصي» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «يطوفون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جهنم»; «آن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حميم», genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the omitted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ).

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «ولمن خاف جنتان» is resumptive; «جنتان» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «لمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «فيهما عينان» is a naʿt (adjective) of {جَنَّتَانِ}, and the clause «تجريان» is a naʿt of «عينان».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «فيهما زوجان» is a naʿt (adjective) of {جَنَّتَانِ}; the preposition «من كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «زوجان».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «متكئين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw that is implied together with its verb, i.e. "they enjoy bliss, reclining". The preposition «على فرش» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متكئين»; the clause «بطائنها من إستبرق» is a naʿt (adjective) of «فرش»; and the clause «وجنى الجنتين دان» is a ḥāl. «جنى» is mubtadaʾ (subject); «دان» is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «فيهن قاصرات» is resumptive; the clause «لم يطمثهن إنس» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قاصرات», because its annexation is verbal (lafẓiyya) [Translator's note: i.e. «قاصرات الطرف» remains indefinite, so a clause can describe it].

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The clause «كأنهن الياقوت والمرجان» is a naʿt (adjective) of {قَاصِرَاتُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «الإحسان» is the khabar (predicate) of «جزاء»; and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «ومن دونهما جنتان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «مدهامَّتان» is a naʿt (adjective) of {جَنَّتَانِ}, and what lies between the adjective and the noun it qualifies is a parenthetical clause.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «فيهما عينان» is a naʿt (adjective) of {جَنَّتَانِ}, and «نضاختان» is a naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «فيهما فاكهة» is a third naʿt (adjective) of {جَنَّتَانِ}.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «فيهن خيرات حسان» is a fourth naʿt (adjective) of {جَنَّتَانِ}.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «حور» is a badal (substitute) from {خَيْرَاتٌ}; the preposition «في الخيام» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مقصورات».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «لم يطمثهن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حور»; the adverb «قبلهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «متكئين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw that is implied together with its verb, i.e. "they enjoy bliss, reclining"; the preposition «على رفرف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «تبارك» is resumptive; «ذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ربك».
